why: Take 3 has the most life: she offers her tips to repay him, then says yes too fast and takes it back. Applied the rules review fix only.
changes: Fixer's third line now reads "Put those away. We don't want paying." Removed "the terrace can see", which read as a rule that onlookers can see a Help; helping has no witnesses [5a29be8544e336060f678471].

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Inez? We've just paid part of your Bureau loan.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Here, tonight's tips. I'll pay you back a little every week.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Put those away. We don't want paying.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I don't know you. Who's been asking about me?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Nobody who'll trouble you. We'd only want a small favour, later.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Thank you, yes, whatever it is. No, wait, I can't, not yet.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Say yes when you mean it. I'll be back with the rest.

learned: Inez took it; not ready yet.
